correctness.rationale: For real ell_3^2 unit vectors, the increasing symmetric cubic difference Phi(u,v)=|u+v|^3-|u-v|^3 forces isosceles orthogonal pairs, modulo signed-coordinate isometries and interchange, to x=(a,b),y=(b,-a), a^3+b^3=1. Both ordered lambda branches were considered. The G branch has denominator minus numerator equal to concave quadratic expressions in the smaller parameter, nonnegative at the explicitly calculated endpoints, hence G<=1. For F(r,lambda)=(1+r^3)(1+lambda^3)/((r+lambda)^3+(1-r lambda)^3), I independently recomputed both symbolic gradients and their elimination in SymPy and recovered the q4(r)=r^4+6r^3+4r^2+2r-1 and q6 factors; the source's degree-six positive Bernstein certificate excludes roots of q6 on [0,1]. The unique q4 root t*=0.27799674994077759 gives the sole relevant interior stationary point (t*,t*), with boundary<=1 and value>1. Independent evaluation gives H3=1.0290679924451533. Source checker independently reconstructs the Sylvester identity by exact evaluation at 25 points and a degree bound. All real quantifiers and boundary values are covered analytically, not by the computed decimal.
